title: PiedMiel - The Texture Pack
description: Oh no ! There is honey everywhere
body:
This texture pack was primary a joke in the Horty's community server... But now you can have it too !

Content :

- All the mobs walked on honey and now they have it all over their legs !
- A variety of mobs with different shades
- Some mobs can be skeleton too now
- Some players have been zombified
- All cooked food were dipped in honey, and have animation !
- Only entity and items are modified by this texture pack. No blocks !
- Have secret weapons by name

You will need [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) mod to have the mob variants. And [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit) for weapons.
Compatible with [Appleskin mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) mod and Fresh Animation's texture pack
